overall: The AG found a Councilor violated the Open Meeting Law by emailing a quorum of the Council about public business, but deemed the Council's September 5, 2013 acknowledgment and email procedures appropriate remedial action, resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a Councilor emailed a quorum of the Council with his opinion on the Mayor's proposed budget and the Council's proposed budget.
allegations.key_passage: We find that a member of the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by sending a June 17, 2013 email to a quorum of the Council regarding public business within the Council's jurisdiction

remedy: Publicly disclose the June 17, 2013 email, if the Council has not already done so.
remedy_passage: We additionally order the Council to publicly disclose the June 17, 2013 email, if it has not done so already.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
